rule_descriptions.F_HOST_RECEIPT_GATE: Four required F-host receipts remain mandatory before final-ready or business-row promotion.
rule_descriptions.SINGLE_RUNNER_GATE: No second runner/task/takeover while canonical recovery is unresolved.
rule_descriptions.SOURCE_SEQUENCE_GATE: Source candidate IDs remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.OPERATION_SEQUENCE_GATE: Operation IDs remain contiguous and unique.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_GUIDE_ROUTING: Use current official guide routing before applying plan rules.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_FRAMEWORK_SCOPE: Keep mapping basis, application plans, boundaries and title-plan guidance as separate evidence roles.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_OS_NOT_PROPERTY_BOUNDARY: OS topographic mapping is not property-boundary evidence.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_MAPPING_ACCURACY_HORIZONTAL: Mapping tolerances are horizontal/planimetric, not vertical terrain error.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_PLAN_SCALE: Application-plan scale/orientation is a plan-quality control.
rule_descriptions.HMLR_SURVEY_SPEC: Registry plan surveying specifications are not LiDAR accuracy specifications.
rule_descriptions.OS_T5_CONTOUR_ENCODING: Terrain5 contour/spot-height encoding is secondary terrain evidence.
rule_descriptions.OS_T5_SPOTHEIGHT_ROUNDING: Rounded spot heights are not equivalent to native EA DTM cells.
rule_descriptions.OS_T5_FEATURE_DATUM: Terrain5 feature datum fields remain explicit.
rule_descriptions.OS_T5_SHAPEFILE_COMPONENTS: Shapefile geometry/index/attribute/projection files have distinct roles.
rule_descriptions.OS_SCHEMA_NOT_MEASUREMENT: Schema validity does not validate numeric height observations.
rule_descriptions.OS_T50_SECONDARY: Terrain50 remains a coarse secondary cross-check.
rule_descriptions.OS_TILE_RELEASE_ID: Whole-tile refresh identifiers are release lineage, not parcel survey identity.
rule_descriptions.OGC_TMS_INDEXING: Tile matrix indexing/scale is delivery geometry, not native sampling evidence.
rule_descriptions.EA_DTM1M_PRIMARY: EA DTM1m remains the primary terrain source.
rule_descriptions.EA_METADATA_INDEX_REQUIRED: Parcel-specific contributing survey remains unknown until metadata-index feature match.
rule_descriptions.EA_DSM_EXCLUDE: DSM and first-return DSM remain excluded from primary bare-earth extrema.
rule_descriptions.NO_DATA_NOT_ZERO: Missing lineage remains unknown and is never converted to zero.
rule_descriptions.NUMERIC_PRESERVATION: Existing measured 1m/2m values remain unchanged during QA.
rule_descriptions.RESULT_CONFIDENCE_ROLE: 96% is repository workflow confidence, not a universal statistical interval.
rule_descriptions.BUSINESS_ROW_GUARD: Business rows remain zero until canonical recovery acceptance.
rule_descriptions.FINAL_READY_GUARD: final_ready remains false while F-host receipts are missing.
rule_descriptions.WEB_OVERLAY_ROLE: Repo overlay visibility is not live port-8012 acceptance.
rule_descriptions.MAIN_MANIFEST_CONCURRENCY: Shared main manifest is not rewritten under concurrent branch activity.
